entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnet ef migrations add in EF Core 11 generates a migration class named after the full migration ID (_20261118152232_AddBlog), which fails CA1707 #39710
  • Negated Contains over a parameter collection ending in null returns no rows on SQL Server #39705
    12.0.0
  • Querying a JSON complex type throws "Expression must be writeable" when a struct has an init-only property of another complex struct #39702
    Backlog

Closed

  • SQLite: AddMonths and AddYears overflow into the next month instead of using the last day of the month #39545
    12.0-preview1
  • No function mapping for DateTime.Ticks in SQL Server #35436
    12.0-preview1
  • Precompiled queries: `ids.Contains(e.Id)` over a captured array or collection fails (MemoryExtensions binding; InvalidCastException in SqlNullabilityProcessor) #39541
    12.0.0
  • Query precompiler rejects required-member DTO initializer because its constructor translates to an invocation #39302
    12.0-preview1
  • Query precompiler aliases Skip and Take into a single SQL parameter #39429
    12.0-preview1
  • Checking equality of values with convertible types makes query precompilation fail #38012
    12.0-preview1
  • Query precompiler fails to lift a double branch in a target-typed nullable conditional #39304
    12.0-preview1
  • [PHISHING] *.EntityFrameworkCore.Design domain is phishing / malware #39688
  • 'Value cannot be null. (Parameter 'collection')' after apply groupBy #33494
    12.0-preview1
  • EF7 - GroupBy resulting in ArgumentNullException - Value cannot be null. (Parameter 'collection'); #31388
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Use SQLite indexes for simple Boolean counts and list queries #39711
    community-contribution
  • SQL Server: read long strings in full when projecting JSON collection elements #39709
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39707
  • Fix SQL Server JSON_CONTAINS type handling #39706
    area-harness
  • Support migration literals for SQL Server full-text catalogs #39704

Merged

  • Avoid FirstWithoutOrderByAndFilterWarning for HAVING filters #39703
    community-contribution
  • Use the last day of the month for AddMonths and AddYears on SQLite #39548
    community-contribution
  • Fix SQL Server precompiled query baseline #39708
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39645
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39691
  • Translate DateTime.Ticks on SQL Server #39532
    community-contribution
  • Fix precompiled queries over captured collections #39685
  • Support required-member DTO initializers in query precompilation #39311
    area-harness
  • Preserve implicit conversions during query precompilation #39313
    area-harness
  • Preserve independent Skip/Take parameters in precompiled queries #39478
    area-harness
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: Include extended error code and guidance in SqliteException messages #39588
    community-contribution
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: Don't retry SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT #39587
    community-contribution
  • Fix final GroupBy over queries with no identifier #39586
    community-contribution

Updated

  • Identify rows of temporal range queries by their period #39661
    community-contribution
  • Propagate column nullability from failed CASE tests to later clauses #39660
    community-contribution
  • Cast all projected date/time and Guid constants #39659
    community-contribution
  • Merge repeated single-row subqueries into one OUTER APPLY on SQL Server #39672
    community-contribution
  • Throw when same-named DbParameters are hard-coded in FromSql/SqlQuery SQL #39593
    breaking-change, community-contribution
  • Translate DateTime.Ticks on SQLite without losing precision #39598
    community-contribution
  • Translate TimeOnly.IsBetween on SQLite #39682
    community-contribution
  • Apply navigation expansion to the rest of a lifted GroupBy projection #39693
    community-contribution
  • Prototype bulk import API (DbSet.ImportFromAsync) (#27333) #39437
    community-contribution
  • Fix MinBy/MaxBy null-key handling with index-friendly selection #39653
    community-contribution
  • Support complex properties on owned types #39522
    community-contribution
  • Drop removed database-level annotations after table and column operations #39666
    community-contribution
  • Lift GroupBy aggregates over navigations next to operator chains #39648
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0]: Bump Microsoft.Build.Utilities.Core from 18.0.2 to 18.0.38 #39620
    area-infrastructure
  • Don't leave the context in a bad state when tracking an entity fails #39614
    community-contribution
  • Always use LF line endings in scaffolded code #39601
    community-contribution
  • Add model-wide and member JSON reader/writer configuration #39483
    api-review
  • Don't treat a filtered index as covering a foreign key index #39652
    community-contribution
  • Translate primitive collections projected through set operations #39561
    community-contribution
  • Throw for proxy navigations whose accessors cannot be overridden #39591
    community-contribution
